metadata.title: Sepia Noir Portrait with Script Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A monochromatic sepia-toned portrait featuring dramatic venetian blind shadow patterns and a large, fluid script signature overlaying the subject.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A sophisticated, warm-toned composition centered on a seated figure in a satin garment, defined by high-contrast horizontal shadow bars and a layered typographic hierarchy combining wide-spaced small caps and expressive large-scale script.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal shadow bars rhythmically intersecting the verticality of the subject
Fluid, teal-toned script contrasting against the rigid sepia photographic base
Wide-spaced serif typography framing the top and bottom of the central figure
Satin fabric highlights echoing the warm glow of the background lighting
coreInvariants: Monochromatic sepia or golden-brown color grading
Venetian blind shadow pattern across the entire scene
Large-scale script signature that overlaps the subject's body

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally seated in a lounge chair, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large script signature in the lower-left quadrant acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text, follow the shadow lines down to the subject's face, then sweep across the script signature to the bottom name.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight framing with minimal negative space, filled primarily by the shadow texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and ochre tones providing the photographic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep chocolate brown for shadows and blind patterns.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted teal or cyan for the script lettering to provide a cool-toned break.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between highlights and deep shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to a monochromatic photographic base with one distinct accent color

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classic Roman Serif and Casual Script
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses high-contrast serifs with extreme horizontal tracking
Script is monolinear, fluid, and features large loops
Bottom name uses a wide, bold serif with sharp terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'C' in the script is oversized, encircling a portion of the composition
The 'i' in the script uses a simple circular dot
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, wide-tracked classical serifs and organic, flowing monolinear script.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top text
The teal color of the script
The overlap of the script onto the subject

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif look for the display text.
Captures the hand-signed feel of the primary overlay.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned photograph of a woman in a satin dress sitting in a vintage armchair, with strong horizontal venetian blind shadows cast across the entire scene.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add wide-spaced serif text in white at the top and bottom edges. Overlay a large, teal-colored flowing script signature across the lower half of the image, partially covering the subject.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly sepia/gold with a teal accent?
Are the horizontal blind shadows clearly visible across the subject?
Is the script lettering large enough to overlap the subject's legs/torso?
Is the top text tracked out with significant space between letters?

adjustableVariables: Scale and placement of the script signature
Tracking width of the serif text
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'Celine Dion'
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the artist
Do not use the specific album title text

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of shadows and subject
avoid: Generic handwriting fonts that lack flow

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script color provides sufficient contrast against the sepia background.
Ensure the shadow lines do not obscure the subject's eyes.
Verify that the wide-tracked text is perfectly centered.
Confirm the film grain texture is consistent across the image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Sepia Portrait + Venetian Blind Shadows + Wide-Tracked Serif + Teal Script Overlay
